newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: George Town to buy Swiss bank group.
newsitem.headline: George Town to buy Swiss bank group.

text.p: Malaysia's George Town Holdings Bhd said on Friday it has entered into separate agreements to acquire 100 percent interest in Swiss bank, Banque Financier de la Cite S.A. (BFC Geneva) and a controlling interest of up to 100 percent in BFC Bank (Cayman) Ltd.

In a statement, George Town said the purchase considerations for BFC Geneva and BFC Cayman will be based on their respective audited net asset values as at March 31, 1997 plus 3.5 percent of the net asset values. As at March 31, 1996, the unaudited net asset value for BFC Geneva was 35.37 million Swiss francs and that for BFC Cayman was $10.49 million.
George Town said the acquisitions will be financed from internal cash resources.
BFC Geneva is involved in asset management and commercial banking/project financing. BFC Cayman conducts a similar business.
George Town operates supermarkets and department stores, and trades in pharmaceuticals.
